sentences.en: It is cruel of you to find fault with her.
sentences.zh: 你批评她未免太残忍了。

sentences.en: The cops are searching for clues to the cruel murder.
sentences.zh: 警察正在寻找那起残忍谋杀案的线索。

sentences.en: It is because he is cruel that I dislike him.
sentences.zh: 我讨厌他就是因为他为人残忍。

senses.zh: 残酷的，残忍的；引起痛苦的
<非正式>弄糟，使没有成功可能
